name: GDB
recent: GDB Holdings 在 2026 年 11 月获得价值 RM877mil 的 Shah Alam 物流中心建筑合约，并取得 RM4.6mil 的法院判决。同期，大股东 Lim Tshung Yaw 增持股份至 6.768%，多名董事在闭市期前后进行股份交易。最新季度（2026 年 9 月止）净利同比下滑 17.69% 至 RM12.14mil，营收同比减少 43.34%。
notable: 获得价值 RM877mil 的 Shah Alam 物流中心建筑合约。
取得针对 Conlay Construction 的 RM4.6mil 法院判决。
大股东 Lim Tshung Yaw 增持 18.18 million 股，持股升至 6.768%。
risks: 存在重大诉讼事项（MATERIAL LITIGATION）。
多名董事及大股东在闭市期前后进行股份交易。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月止季度营收为 RM142.48mil，环比下降 15.7%，同比下降 21.2%；净利为 RM13.20mil，环比下降 38.7%，同比下降 39.3%；净利率从 12.7% 降至 9.3%。2026 年 9 月止季度净利同比下滑 17.69% 至 RM12.14mil，营收同比减少 43.34%。

recent_en: In November 2026, GDB Holdings secured a RM877mil construction contract for a logistics hub in Shah Alam and obtained a RM4.6mil court judgement. Meanwhile, substantial shareholder Lim Tshung Yaw raised his stake to 6.768%, and several directors traded shares around the closed period. Latest quarter (ended Sep 2026) net profit fell 17.69% YoY to RM12.14mil, with revenue down 43.34% YoY.
notable_en: Secured a RM877mil construction contract for a logistics hub in Shah Alam.
Obtained a RM4.6mil court judgement against Conlay Construction.
Substantial shareholder Lim Tshung Yaw acquired 18.18 million shares, raising stake to 6.768%.
risks_en: There is a material litigation matter.
Several directors and substantial shareholders traded shares around the closed period.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended June 2026, revenue was RM142.48mil, down 15.7% QoQ and 21.2% YoY; net income was RM13.20mil, down 38.7% QoQ and 39.3% YoY; net margin fell from 12.7% to 9.3%. For the quarter ended September 2026, net profit fell 17.69% YoY to RM12.14mil, with revenue down 43.34% YoY.
